name: Spawnbroker — A leaves out your shroud creature, B the opponent's hexproof and protection-from-blue creatures
notes: "When this creature enters, you may exchange control of target creature you control and target creature with power less than or equal to that creature's power an opponent controls." (2026-10-18, exchange-control targeting part 2.) Both are targets, so shroud keeps Argothian Enchantress out of A, while your own Gladecover Scout stays (hexproof only stops opponents). With Hill Giant as A, B holds Grizzly Bears, not the opponent's Gladecover Scout (hexproof) or Karoo Meerkat (protection from blue). Before, all of them were listed.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.
